information_wall.policy_input: correct task language plus current policy observation only

adapter.initialization: fresh deterministic functional identity from the frozen source base for each stage

data.sampling: task-balanced deterministic no-replacement episode cycles; deterministic frame within each episode visit

profile_evidence.planned_check: Four real optimizer steps at rank 128 and batch 64 per rank must be finite and leave stable device headroom before the formal capacity comparison is sealed.

development.selection_data: sealed eight validation tasks; no validation actions

prior_matched_scale_result.interpretation: The prior matched-scale pilot stopped during the inherited 1,000-step warmup while loss was still descending; it is provenance, not the Source-SFT ceiling.

formal_run.selection_rule: Capacity diagnostic against the completed rank-16 Source-SFT ceiling: train a fresh rank-128 shared LoRA, with alpha/rank kept at one, using the same 800-step scheduler horizon, batch, data, seed, and information wall. Stop first at step 400, screen steps 100/200/400, and exact-resume only to 600 or 800 if evidence remains unsaturated. Full-evaluate only the few candidates needed to locate its validation peak. This tests whether the 119/400 collapsed Writer-v1 result over rank-16 Source-SFT 87/400 is explained by roughly ten-fold trainable-parameter capacity; it is not constrained to the Writer LoRA rank.

final.selection_data: no test outcomes; retrain once from fresh identity after development selection

formal_run.selection_rule: copy the frozen development hyperparameters and retrain from the prescribed fresh identity state; never resume the development LoRA; stop at the selected schedule or guardrail and record any apparent undertraining

checkpointing.retained_state: shared LoRA, optimizer, scheduler, per-rank RNG, deterministic sampler cursor, metrics cursor, contract and hashes
